principle: A trigger only adds candidate articles. It never establishes an offense.
negative_contexts: сатирический/иронический контекст без иных признаков состава
сообщение о действиях третьего лица без присоединения к ним
judge_instruction: Explain which exact words form the legally relevant action, who is the subject/target, whether publication/message is public or private when that matters, and which qualifying facts are present or absent. If these facts cannot be established from text, prefer NONE or a lower-confidence candidate rather than asserting a violation.

confidence_policy.high: The text itself contains the action plus the material context needed for the candidate.
confidence_policy.medium: Strong clues exist but one legally important fact is missing or ambiguous.
confidence_policy.low: Only topic words or emotional language are present. Do not surface as a likely offense.
